tools.name: cc_open_prefab
tools.description: Open a prefab into an isolated sandbox node ("__CC2MCP_PREFAB_SANDBOX__/<name>"), inactive so it does not affect scene rendering. Use the returned sandboxPath/sandboxUuid for subsequent node/component operations, then cc_close_prefab to save and clean up.

tools.name: cc_close_prefab
tools.description: Close an open prefab sandbox. If save=true, serializes the sandbox subtree back to its original .prefab file before removing the sandbox node.

sandboxUuid.description: Sandbox root node UUID returned by cc_open_prefab

sandboxPath.description: Sandbox root node path (alternative to sandboxUuid)

save.description: Save changes back to the original .prefab file before cleanup

tools.name: cc_list_prefab_sandboxes
tools.description: List all currently-open prefab sandboxes (opened via cc_open_prefab).

tools.name: cc_edit_prefab_property
tools.description: Edit a component property inside a .prefab file directly (no scene instantiation, no sandbox). For cc.Node refs to other nodes in the same prefab, pass value as {__ref__: "internalNodePath"}; for asset refs pass {__uuid__: "..."}; primitives go through as-is.

nodePath.description: Node path inside the prefab relative to its root (e.g. "bg" or "UI_Root/titleLabel"). Empty/omitted = root node.

componentType.description: Component class name as stored in __type__ (e.g. cc.Sprite, ad_engine_SkuBuyView)

value.description: Value to set. Use {__ref__:"internalPath"} for cc.Node refs inside this prefab, {__uuid__:"..."} for asset refs, arrays/primitives as normal.
